rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God makes the servant recognize His independence and the servant's need, so He may honor and shelter the servant within grace.
rows.anchor: عرفك أنه غني عنك ، وأشهدك موضع فقرك إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each person answers for their own deeds and record, and has an individual relation with God.
rows.anchor: كل مطالب بعمله ، وكل محاسب عن ديوانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Proxy applies to some worship but not gnosis; even thousands of saints cannot make up a sinner's missed prayer unless the sinner performs it.
rows.anchor: ومن العبادات ما تجري فيه النيابة ولكن في المعارف لا تجري النيابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine reproach and address are personal: no one else hears the address meant for the servant, whose place in God's heart is preserved.
rows.anchor: فعتابك لا يجري مع غيرك والخطاب الذي معك لا يسمعه غيرك

words: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Warning is alerting someone to danger and khashya is fear; warning benefits only those who have fear, like creatures gathering with their own kind.
rows.anchor: الإنذار هو الإعلام بموضع المخافة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Blind and seeing, darkness and light, shade and heat, and living and dead are unlike states and cannot be equated.
rows.anchor: كما لا يستوي الأعمى والبصير لا تستوي الظلمات والنور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The contrasts signify those joined to God versus distracted from Him, drawn near versus veiled, chosen versus forsaken, and made witnesses versus heedless.
rows.anchor: وكذلك لا يستوي الموصول بنا والمشغول عنا ، والمجذوب إلينا

rows.speaker: منشدون
rows.claim: An anonymous poem says God's lovers differ sharply from those who oppose Him.
rows.anchor: أحبابنا شتان : واف وناقض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No age or people lacked a warner, while Muhammad was uniquely sent with truth to all peoples and all creation.
rows.anchor: وما من أمة ممن كانوا من قبلك إلا بعثنا فيهم نذيرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rejection of Muhammad repeats the pattern faced by every prophet; God's established course of punishment and disgrace does not change.
rows.anchor: أي لو قابلوك بالتكذيب فتلك سنتهم مع كل نبى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Differences of form and color show the agent's deliberate choice, while the work's precision testifies to the Maker's knowledge.
rows.anchor: تخصيص الفعل بهيئاته وألوانه من أدلة قصد الفاعل وبرهانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All creatures are alike in kind yet varied, which proves the existence of their Creator with the attribute of majesty.
rows.anchor: بل جميع المخلوقات متجانس الأعيان مختلف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Innama marks emphasis and restriction: whoever lacks knowledge of God has no fear of Him.
rows.anchor: كلمة تحقيق تجري من وجه مجرى التحديد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rahba is fear that drives a person to flee, whereas khashya restrains the person and keeps them with God.
rows.anchor: الفرق بين الخشية والرهبة أن الرهبة خوف يوجب هرب صاحبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear follows faith, khashya follows knowledge, and awe follows gnosis.
rows.anchor: والخوف قضية الإيمان ، قال تعالى

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: Reported explanations say scholars fear falling short in God's due and feel modest before His awareness.
rows.anchor: ويقال خشية العلماء من تقصيرهم في أداء حقه

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: A further explanation is that scholars fear bad manners, disrespect, untimely familiarity in speech, or leaving what is better.
rows.anchor: ويقال حذرا من أن يحصل لهم سوء أدب وترك احترام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who spend their time in remembrance, fulfilling God's rights, worship, and acts of closeness receive the greatest nearness and welcome.
rows.anchor: الذين يستغرق جميع أوقاتهم قيامهم بذكر الله وبحقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those whose states are the opposite have the opposite outcome: the former are honored friends, the latter humbled enemies.
rows.anchor: وأما الذين أحوالهم بالضد فمنالهم على العكس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God chose, singled out, and preferred the beloved person; an accompanying poem expresses exclusive love.
rows.anchor: ما عرفناك - من اختارنا لك وتخصيصنا إياك

rows.speaker: منشدون
rows.claim: An anonymous poem says the speaker seeks no beloved in place of the one addressed.
rows.anchor: وأنشدوا : لا أبتغي بدلا سواك خليلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Awrathna means God gave the Quran to those He chose; inheritance is figurative and istafayna means We chose.
rows.anchor: أي أعطينا الكتاب - أي القرآن - الذين اصطفينا من عبادنا

rows.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
rows.claim: On this verse's revelation, the Prophet said three times, By the Lord of the Kaaba, my community.
rows.anchor: قال عليه السلام : ( أمتي ورب الكعبة ) ثلاث مرات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inheritance implies a specific lineage and cause: spiritual lineage is gnosis, while its cause is obedience.
rows.anchor: فالميراث يقتضى صحة النسب على وجه مخصوص

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: An alternative assigns lineage to God's favor and the cause to the servant's action.
rows.anchor: وإن قيل محل النسب فضله ، ومحل السبب فعلك

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: Another alternative takes lineage as God's initial choosing and cause as His later beneficence.
rows.anchor: ويصح أن يقال محل النسب اختياره لك بدءا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of spiritual lineage occupy stronger and lesser degrees in what they are entitled to receive.
rows.anchor: ويقال أهل النسب على أقسام : - الأقوى ، والأدنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ownership analogy requires servant participation: even a gift must be accepted, and entitlement requires presence and striving.
rows.anchor: ولا يحصل الاستحقاق إلا بالحضور والمجاهدة وغير ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people acknowledged that creating the heavens and earth is greater than creating them again, yet denied resurrection after becoming dust.
rows.anchor: أي خلق السموات والأرض أكبر من بعثهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The contrast is mapped to believer and unbeliever, the desire-bound and spiritually opened, the drawn near and veiled, and the fortunate and wretched.
rows.anchor: ما يستوي المؤمن والكافر ، ولا المربوط بشهوته كالمبسوط بصفوته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The appointed reckoning remains certain even while its allotted interval runs.
rows.anchor: أن ميقات الحساب لكان وإن وقعت المدة في أوانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promise to answer prayer is qualified by God's will, as another verse says He removes what people invoke Him to remove if He wills.
rows.anchor: أدعوني اأستجب لكم إن شئت

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: One view makes lawful food a condition of supplication, whose key is need and whose cause is a lawful morsel.
rows.anchor: ويقال ادعوني بشرط الدعاء

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: One view says God answers everyone who calls, either with the requested thing or with something better.
rows.anchor: ويقال كل من دعاه استجاب له إما بما يشاء له

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: One view says an unbeliever does not truly invoke God because the unbeliever invokes a partner, while God has no partner.
rows.anchor: الكافر ليس يدعوه ؛ لأنه إنما يدعو من له شريك

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: If the address is to believers, they receive what they ask for in this life; God may defer it for the afterlife, making the servant wish it had all been deferred.
rows.anchor: إذا ثبت أن هذا الخطاب للمؤمنين

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: Spiritual readings pair prayer with obedience, freedom from heedlessness, repentance, effort, or asking, and pair the answer with reward, immediacy, grace, relief, or generosity.
rows.anchor: ادعوني بالطاعات استجب لكم بالثواب والدرجات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here worship means supplication: those who proudly refuse to call on God enter Hell humbled.
rows.anchor: أن يستكبرون عن دعائي ، سيدخلون جهنم صاغرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nighttime rest varies: the heedless rest in heedlessness, while lovers rest through their bond with God.
rows.anchor: سكون الناس في الليل على أقسام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some rest among peers or in the sweetness of their deeds and self-regard, while people of longing find no rest by night or day.
rows.anchor: قوم يسكنون إلى أمثالهم وأشكالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of longing have no repose by night or day and remain aflame; God is the one with whom they rest, for whom they are stirred, and in whom they love.
rows.anchor: قوم يعدمون القرار في ليلهم ونهارهم وأولئك اصحاب الاشتياق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God makes their rest with Him, their agitation and longing for Him, and their love and detachment toward Him.
rows.anchor: الذي جعل سكونكم معه ، وانزعاجكم له ، واشتياقكم إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God could have gathered everyone in guidance or error without opposition; He created them diverse as He willed, and no one can resist His will.
rows.anchor: إن أراد أن يجمعهم كلهم على الهدى والرشاد لم يكن مانع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone governs all affairs, good and evil, benefit and harm, and gives life and death to souls and hearts in this world and the next.
rows.anchor: إنه إله واحد جبار غير مأمور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Judgment returns to God's Book, the Prophet's Sunnah, consensus, and analogical reasoning; the Quran establishes the validity of this legal framework.
rows.anchor: أي إلى كتاب الله ، وسنة نبيه ، وإجماع الأئمة

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: When intuitions conflict and one cannot find guidance, abandon personal planning, rely on God's decree, and await what He enables.
rows.anchor: إذا لم تهتدوا إلى شيء وتعارضت منكم الخواطر

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: When the heart wonders whether its destiny is felicity or wretchedness, entrust that unknown outcome to God and attend to His present command.
rows.anchor: إذا اشتغلت قلوبكم بحديث أنفسكم ؛ لا تدرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Azwaj means forms or kinds; Eve was created from Adam, and animals were made in species to sustain reproduction.
rows.anchor: خلق لكم من أنفسكم ( أزواحا ) : أي أشكالا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yadhraukum means that God multiplies your creation.
rows.anchor: يكثر خلقكم . ( فيه ) الهاء تعود إلى البطن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun in fihi refers to the abdomen, meaning creation is multiplied within it.
rows.anchor: الهاء تعود إلى البطن أي في البطن

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: An alternative says the pronoun refers to the womb.
rows.anchor: في البطن ، وقيل : في الرحم ، وقيل

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: Another alternative says the pronoun refers to marriage.
rows.anchor: وقيل : في الرحم ، وقيل : في التزويج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nothing resembles God because He originates the heavens and earth and has no comparable likeness in His essence, attributes, or judgments.
rows.anchor: لأنه فاطر السموات والأرض ، ولأنه لا مثل يضارعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The kaf in kamithlihi can be treated as an extra connective, so the phrase means nothing is like God.
rows.anchor: والكاف في ليس ( كمثله ) صلة أي ليس مثله شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The source condemns those who give God bounds, location, limbs, or tools, including imagining sight in an eye, hearing in an organ, and power in a hand.
rows.anchor: وقد وقع قوم في تشبيه ذاته بذات المخلوقين فوصفوه بالحد والنهاية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He rejects measuring God's judgments by human standards of good and evil and affirms transcendence and unity without delimitation, denial, or likeness.
rows.anchor: وقوم قاسوا حكمه على حكم عباده ؛ فقالوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Maqalid means keys; keys open treasuries, and God's treasuries are His decreed possibilities.
rows.anchor: أي مفاتيح ، والمفاتيح للخزائن ، وخزائنه مقدوراته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As creation has different stores, hearts contain different states: gnosis, love, longing, intimacy, unity, singularity, awe, and contentment.
rows.anchor: وكما أن في الموجودات معادن مختلفة فكذلك القلوب معادن جواهر الأحوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing that God owns the keys turns the servant from creatures toward Him for bodily and spiritual provision, which He expands or restricts as He wills.
rows.anchor: أن المقاليد له : أن يقطع العبد أفكاره عن الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shara'a means to clarify and make manifest.
rows.anchor: أي بين وأظهر . { من الدين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shared religion means its foundations, while branches differ; the verse also indicates that some legal rulings are common to all revealed laws.
rows.anchor: أراد به أصول الدين ؛ فإنها لا تختلف

words: أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to establish religion and avoid division clarifies the shared fundamentals across prophetic laws.
rows.anchor: ثم بين ذلك بقوله : { أن أقيموا الدين ولا تتفرقوا فيه }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A narrative says the prohibition of marrying daughters and sisters was instituted in Noah's time.
rows.anchor: وفي القصة أن تحريم البنات والأخوات إنما شرع في زمان نوح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They persisted in falsehood and divided only after clear proof came, leaving no excuse or doubt; envy drove their defiance.
rows.anchor: يعني أنهم أصروا على باطلهم بعد وضوح البيان وظهور البرهان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God had decreed punishment be delayed until Judgment Day; without that term, He would have hastened it.
rows.anchor: وهو انه حكم بتأخير العقوبة إلى يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At rare times God brings distant homes together and reunites people, seeing blessing for the world's life in their gathering; He can gather them whenever He wills.
rows.anchor: قد يتفضل الحق عليهم فتدنو بهم الديار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When misfortune comes, the servant should recognize it as punishment for bad manners, feel ashamed, and correct himself instead of seeking revenge or praying against others.
rows.anchor: إذا أصابته شظية أو حالة مما يسوءه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repeated afflictions should lead a servant to examine blameworthy deeds and grieve over the sins for which even much pardon has not removed the consequences.
rows.anchor: فليفكر في أفعاله المذمومة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sends winds to move ships and stills them at other times, showing people peril and safety and urging reflection.
rows.anchor: يريد بها السفن التي تجري في البحار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God restrains storms and shelters people in safety; gratitude is due in every state, and sincere gratitude merits abundant increase.
rows.anchor: والإشارة في هذا إلى إمساك الناس في خلال فترة الوقت

words: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worldly ease is never free of troubles and, when it occurs, quickly passes; God's promised reward is better than the little present.
rows.anchor: يعني أن الراحات في الدنيا لا تصفو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Major sins means associating partners with God and indecencies means lesser slips; avoiding them calms the self as people trust God in every state.
rows.anchor: ما دون ذلك من الزلات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who respond to God obey His calls and commands through many kinds of worship, receiving a good reward and praiseworthy return.
rows.anchor: فيما دعاهم إليه وما أمرهم به من فنون الطاعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The true respondent has no breath left except in conformity with God's pleasure and retains nothing for the ego.
rows.anchor: والمستجيب لربه هو الذي لا يبقى له نفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They do not impose their opinions because they distrust their judgment, and entrust decisions to God.
rows.anchor: لا يستبد أحدهم برأيه ؛ لأنه يتهم أمره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant sees wrong as stemming from his own self, and takes revenge on that self by restraining it from disobedience.
rows.anchor: فيعلم أحدهم أن الظلم الذي أصابه هو من قبل نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Retaliation must not exceed the injury inflicted; recompense and revenge are limited to the offender's measure.
rows.anchor: يعني لا تجاوزوا حد ما جنى الجاني عليكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever forgives the offender and repairs his relation with God will have God repair his relations with people; God's reward is better than what the servant chooses.
rows.anchor: من عفا عن الجاني ، وأصلح ما بينه وبين الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since servants cannot fully escape the ego or perfect their character, God permits just retaliation, though pardon is preferable.
rows.anchor: علم الله أن الكل من عباده لا يجد التحرر من أحكام النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Blame applies to those who exceed the permitted limit and commit an unauthorized act; they face painful punishment.
rows.anchor: السبيل بالملامة لمن جاوز الحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person of resolve bears affliction without complaint, forgives the opponent without keeping a claim, and absolves him in this life and the next.
rows.anchor: صبر على البلاء من غير شكوى ، وغفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those God led astray have no protector or defense from punishment; brought humiliated before the Fire, their regret and pleas bring no help or mercy.
rows.anchor: إن الذين أضلهم الله ، وأعمى أبصارهم وبصائرهم

words: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Polytheist unbelievers remain in Hell forever, with neither respite nor reduction; monotheists who enter it do not remain forever.
rows.anchor: هؤلاء هم الكفار المشركون ، فهم أهل الخلود

rows.speaker: خبر صحيح
rows.claim: A report graded sound says God does not let the people of the Fire die before taking them out, since the dead cannot feel or suffer.
rows.anchor: ورد في الخبر الصحيح : أنه لا يميتهم الحق - سبحانه - إماتة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblas means disappointment; this implies believers in Hell are not despairing but remain hopeful until their reckoning ends.
rows.anchor: الإبلاس من الخيبة ويدل ذلك على أن المؤمنين لا يأس لهم فيها

rows.speaker: الشيوخ
rows.claim: The shaykhs say a believer's state in Hell is in one respect easier than worldly life: he fears destruction today but is certain of rescue tomorrow.
rows.anchor: إن حال المؤمن في النار - من وجه - أروح لقلبه من حاله في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement resembles an excuse or apology, though God is far exalted above needing to make an excuse.
rows.anchor: هذا الخطاب يشبه كلمة العذر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Had they addressed Malik, their words might have been nearer to an answer, but estrangement kept them from it; they are told they remain because they rejected counsel and hated truth.
rows.anchor: لو قالوا : ( يا ملك ) لعل أقوالهم كانت أقرب إلى الإجابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are told they will remain because they were counseled but refused advice and hated the truth.
rows.anchor: نصحتم فلم تنتصحوا ، ولم تقبلوا القول في حينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their plans fall apart and none of their designs succeeds; this is clear evidence for the Creator.
rows.anchor: بل أمورهم منتقضة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning mentions angels hearing and recording deeds because sinners are heedless of God; awareness that deeds are recorded reduces careless sinning.
rows.anchor: إنما خوفهم بسماع الملك ، وبكتابتهم أعمالهم عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet says that if they believe or imagine the Merciful has a child, he would be the first to disavow that claim.
rows.anchor: أي إن كان في ضميركم وفي حكمكم وفي اعتقادكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is glorified and transcendent above the descriptions they make of Him.
rows.anchor: تنزه الله تنزيها ، وتقدس تقديسا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage permits quoting an innovator's erroneous description of God to refute it and expose its ugliness and falsehood.
rows.anchor: وفي هذه الآيات وأمثالها دليل على جواز حكاية قول المبتدعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their affair will not escape them and they will meet humiliation, so servants should not be deceived by a long period of apparent safety.
rows.anchor: إذ ليس يفوت أمرهم ، وهم لا محالة سيلقون صغرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone is worshiped in Heaven and is the one to whom people on earth turn for their needs; no other being fulfills them.
rows.anchor: المعبود - في السماء - الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is wise in delaying punishment for sinners and knows the conditions of His servants.
rows.anchor: وهو الحكيم } في إمهاله للغصاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is exalted and owns creation; the heavens and earth appear by His power, and He is not enhanced by their existence.
rows.anchor: تعالى وتقدس وتنزه وتكبر الذي له ملك السموات والأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who witness to monotheism knowingly in this life qualify for intercession, and the verse shows all Muslims' intercession will be accepted in the next.
rows.anchor: أي شهد - اليوم - بالتوحيد ، فيثبت له الحق حق الشفاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since they admit God created them, they should reflect on why they turn away and become proud of disobeying Him.
rows.anchor: فكيف لا يعتبرون ؟ وكيف يتكبرون عن طاعة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows the Hour and the Prophet's complaint; fasfah means give them respite, tell them peace, and they will learn the punishment they deserve.
rows.anchor: أي يعلم علم الساعة ويعلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala strips hearts, overcomes minds, gives to the obedient, and withholds from knowers; those who receive it get divine gentleness, while the deprived are effaced.
rows.anchor: كلمة للقولب سالبة ، للعقول غالبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God protects hearts under His care from conjecture and establishes them in witnessed certainty through verification, signs, grace, intimacy, and nearness.
rows.anchor: حميت قلوب أهل عنايتي فصرفت عنها خواطر التجويز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Aziz honors believers by sending the Book, and al-Hakim protects the Book from alteration and change.
rows.anchor: المعز للمؤمنين بإنزال الكتاب عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unbelievers turn away from what should warn them and persist in refusal.
rows.anchor: الكافرون معرضون عن موضع الإنذار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge asks whether idols have any effect in dominion or power to benefit and harm; if worshipers have proof, they should produce it, and otherwise abandon error.
rows.anchor: أي أثر فيهم في الملك ، أو القدرة على النفع والضر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one is more astray than a person who worships an inanimate object without life or any established power to help or harm.
rows.anchor: من أشد ضلالا ممن عبد الجماد الذي ليس له حياة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the gathering for judgment, idols become enemies of those who worshiped them.
rows.anchor: إذا حشر الناس للحساب وقعت العداوة بين الأصنام وعابديها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When clear signs are recited, unbelievers call the truth sorcery and accuse messengers of fabrication.
rows.anchor: رموا رسلنا بالسحر ثم بالافتراء والمكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God suffices as witness: opponents associate partners while the Prophet proclaims unity and follows the monotheistic foundations of earlier messengers.
rows.anchor: كفى بالله بيني وبينكم شهيدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's mission is to call people to sincere unity, truthful servanthood, and good character.
rows.anchor: إنما أمرتكم بالإخلاص في التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala repairs the condition of those receiving mercy and manifests overpowering majesty toward those condemned; God knows worshipers' hidden efforts and forgives sinners' grave sins.
rows.anchor: اسم جبر أحوال من رحمه ، متجبر بكبريائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Q is the key to divine names Strong, Able, All-Powerful, and Near; God swears by these names and the glorious Quran.
rows.anchor: ق مقتاح أسمائه : ( قوي وقادر وقدير وقريب )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One proposed, omitted response to the oath is that they will indeed be raised at the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: وجواب القسم محذوف ومعناه لتبعثن في القيامة

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: One proposed response is that God knows what the earth consumes of the dead and keeps a preserving record; the delayed response is marked by an emphatic lām.
rows.anchor: جوابه : { قد علمنا ما تنقص الأرض منهم وعندنا كتاب حفيظ }

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: Another proposed response to the oath is the later statement that God's word will not be changed.
rows.anchor: جوابه قوله : { ما يبدل القول لدى }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warner from among the people is Muhammad; astonishment expresses the soul's rejection of an unusual matter it has not previously known.
rows.anchor: هو محمد . والتعجب نوع من تعبير النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Astonishment expresses the soul's rejection of an unusual matter it has not previously known.
rows.anchor: والتعجب نوع من تعبير النفس عن استبعادها لأمر خارج العادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unbelievers deny resurrection and deem it far-fetched that they could be raised after dying and becoming dust.
rows.anchor: وقد مضى القول في إنكارهم للبعث واستبعادهم ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows the scattered remains of the dead; this consoles the buried servant after loved ones leave, perhaps telling angels how the body has broken down and dispersed.
rows.anchor: ولعله يخبر الملائكة قائلا : عبدي الذي أخرجته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preserving book is the Preserved Tablet, recording creation's states without forgetfulness and what the servant needs to recall.
rows.anchor: وهو اللوح المحفوظ ؛ أثبتنا فيه تفصيل أحوال الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Marij means mixed and confused: they wander in perplexity and fluctuate in doubt.
rows.anchor: أي مختلط وملتبس ؛ فهم يترددون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should consider the raised, leveled heaven, adorned with stars, sun, and moon, and its lack of cracks.
rows.anchor: أولم يعتبروا ؟ أو لم يستدلوا بما رفعنا فوقهم من السماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The varied character of the sky and its effects also provide evidence for God's creation.
rows.anchor: أو لم يروا كيف جنسناعينها ونوعنا أثرها ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God spread the earth as a resting place, set mountains as stakes, and grew trees, flowers, and beautiful plants there.
rows.anchor: والأرض مددناها ؛ فجعناها لهم مهادا
